name: hs-hold
note: THE 250-400 m/s HOLE IN THE CORPUS, AND THE ONE DEFECT THAT LIVES IN IT. captures.db (3027 captures) has ZERO rows between 250 and 400 m/s and every airframe tops out at 221 m/s, because every card enters at ~1.0x corner and nothing accelerates. debugtests/DISCORD-V68-TRIAGE.md section 2 is a field report from exactly the missing band: an FS-12 at 348-400 m/s limit-cycling the ROLL axis at ~2 Hz WHILE ON TARGET - targetBank -0.16 deg mean, off 0.19 deg, elevErr sd 0.03 deg, and outR swinging -0.53..+0.62 with rollRate +-0.77 and Rflip 105 in 29.6 s. The outer loop is commanding nothing and the inner roll servo is oscillating on its own: RollDamping x rollRateF overwhelming a still-live P-error and inverting the stick (t=223.500 bank -6.8 vs target 0.0 -> outR +0.509; 0.18 s later the error is still +5.1 the same direction and outR is -0.230). That is GENERALITY-REVIEW.md finding 5 (RollGain/RollDamping/RollRateSmoothing are global constants, unnormalized by q) plus its internal twin, 1.28 Hz on Multirole1 at ~450 m/s (rec 014141). This card exists to put that state on the schedule instead of waiting for another Discord post. NAMING TRAP: FS-12 IS 'Fighter1'. 'SmallFighter1' is the FS-20 Vortex - see AIRFRAMES.md. GEOMETRY IS THE FIELD REPORT'S OWN PROTOCOL: level, no elevation demand at all, a small azimuth offset held for 30 s, i.e. settled on-boresight cruise - NOT a maneuver. The 2 deg mirrored steps into fineHS1R/L are the transient; the measurement is the settled tail of each 30 s hold, where azErr is ~0 and the law should be commanding nothing. fineHS05R/L add a mirrored 0.5 deg pair, inside the v0.65 settle cone, to catch the entry transient at the scale the field report actually sat at. ENTRY IS 2.2x THE FBW CORNER, AND 2.2 IS NOT A ROUND NUMBER: it is the largest multiple every lane clears at the v0.92 envelope gate. 0.95 x Vmax / FBW corner is 2.28 for FastBomber1 (the binding lane), 2.38 Fighter1, 2.47 Multirole1, 2.55 SmallFighter1, so 2.3 already refuses a lane pre-spawn. 2.2 places 352 / 352 / 341 / 440 m/s - the band the corpus has never seen, bracketing the field report's 348-423. THE ROSTER IS NOT A CHOICE, IT IS THE SET THAT CLEARS: of the ten fixed-wing keys, 2.2x refuses trainer (286 vs 279.7), VTOLTrainer1 (352 vs 279.7), CAS1 (352 vs 195.3), COIN (242 vs 134.6) and EW1 (286 vs 271.8) at the gate. Darkreach is the one key left out by hand - it clears (220 vs 265.2) but 2.2 x its 100 corner does not reach the band this card exists to fill, so it would spend a lane measuring 220 m/s again. WHY THIS ENTRY IS HOLDABLE AND stol-sweep's WAS NOT, which is the whole design: R39-stol measured these same jets running to 340-381 m/s on a pinned 1.00 throttle at 2500-6000 m, i.e. full throttle TRIMS them right here. The stol cards had to fight that (declared 90, flew 381); this card asks for the speed the pin already holds, so the placement and the trim agree instead of racing. ScenarioThrottle is pinned at 1.00 for that reason and must not be lowered - at 0.70 the entry becomes a deceleration and the card slides back out of the band. Nothing HOLDS the speed either way (AuditHold is instrument, not controller), so grep 'ENTRY CONDITION NOT HELD' before scoring, and read spd on the first capture: anything still above ~300 m/s at the end of fineHS1L is in band. NO VERTICAL DEMAND ANYWHERE, so 90 s at 4000 m cannot reach the 500 m FloorAltM abort - unlike every other high-energy card in the grid, this one has no altitude budget to blow. Drone/DroneAltDeckM can be LEFT AT ITS 3000 DEFAULT here, which is the opposite of the stol cards' instruction: the decks put half the fleet at 2500 m and half at 5500 m, q 59.5 vs 43.5 kPa, crossed with airframe on the Latin-square diagonal - a balanced dynamic-pressure factor inside one card, and q is the exact variable finding 5 is about. Both decks stay far above the corpus's highest q (25.6 kPa at 250 m/s / 4000 m) and far above any stall margin, so neither deck falls out of the regime. Set it to 0 only if you want the declared altitude exactly. PASS = outR sd under ~0.05 over the settled tail with no sustained sign flipping: wobbleFreqHzOutR ABSENT (osc_mode found no supportable mode), wobbleEpisodesOutR 0, stickFlipRateR at the oblique family's level, and the R/L mirror pairs within noise of each other. FAIL = the R6-02 signature: wobbleFreqHzOutR 1-2 Hz with wobbleCoherenceOutR high, wobbleEpisodesOutR > 0 at pp 0.3+, stickFlipRateR several per second, all of it while targetBank is ~0 and off is under 1 deg. Read targetBank/tBankE beside it - a limit cycle WITH a live bank demand is a different (outer-loop) defect and belongs to the oblique family, not here.
